source: Verified research, Cursor entry: https://cursor.com/docs/hooks and the local 2.5.26 agent-exec bundle; skeptic checked the 3.20.17 per-user install (hook_pre_tool, hook_session_start and hook_stop corrected).

sniff.source: Cursor hook_pre_tool: hook env vars CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (alias), CURSOR_VERSION, CURSOR_TRANSCRIPT_PATH; imported Claude hooks still get Cursor payloads (hook_event_name preToolUse, tool_name Shell).

selection.bareNote: preToolUse is not a Claude event, so with no flag and no Cursor env the deny is exit 2, which Cursor documents as equivalent to permission deny.

deny.source: Cursor hook_pre_tool: exit 0 with {permission: deny, user_message, agent_message}; 2.5.26 does not parse hookSpecificOutput (skeptic: 3.20.17 does, only when the flat keys are absent).

context.source: Cursor hook_session_start: {additional_context} on sessionStart (local 2.5.26 validator; skeptic: shape right).

PreToolUse.source: Cursor hook_payload_example: the docs preToolUse example with the 2.5.26 bundle's Shell input {command, cwd}

PostToolUse.source: Cursor hook_post_tool: postToolUse input tool_name, tool_input, tool_output, tool_use_id, cwd, duration

UserPromptSubmit.source: Cursor hook_user_prompt: beforeSubmitPrompt input prompt and attachments

SessionStart.source: Cursor hook_session_start: sessionStart input session_id, is_background_agent, composer_mode plus the common fields

SessionEnd.source: Cursor hook_pre_tool: the bundle maps SessionEnd to sessionEnd; its input keys are not in the verified research

Stop.source: Cursor hook_stop: stop input status (completed|aborted|error) and loop_count
